# Dental Data
```{r setup, include = TRUE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
# Load the necessary packages
library(tidyverse)
 
# Read the dental screening data
dental_data <- dental
```

## Statistics
```{r}

df <- data.frame(dental_data)
attach(df)
x <- summary(age)
print(x)
m <- mean(age)
print(m)
hist(age)

```
